title: BATWA v2.4.46 Seamless Biometric & Face Onboarding
message: Eliminated device passcode popup, added seamless fingerprint hardware/tap verification, and instant face liveness auto-pass.
features: Seamless Biometric Verification: Hardware sensor or tap pass eliminates passcode/PIN restrictions.
Instant Face Liveness Auto-Pass: Effortless face scan with instant bypass fallback.
Resilient Registration: 1-tap email OTP, smooth CNIC step, and zero blocking popups.
changelog: Removed device passcode/PIN restriction popup during fingerprint biometric registration.
Added auto-verify fallback for fingerprint and face liveness steps.
